comparisons.peer_topic: Level 3 Investment Gains and Losses for 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: The net realized and unrealized gains on level 3 investments were $55 million for the year ended December 2024, comprising $342 million of net realized gains and $287 million of net unrealized losses, with specific allocations to other principal transactions and interest income.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and GS report specific performance metrics for Level 3 investments in their fiscal year disclosures, but they focus on different aspects of the rollforward. BAC discloses the net change in the Level 3 investment balance driven by returns and purchases/sales, noting a $16 million increase in 2023. In contrast, GS breaks down the performance into realized and unrealized gains/losses, reporting a net $55 million gain on Level 3 investments in 2024, comprised of significant realized gains offset by unrealized losses. While both address Level 3 investment performance, BAC's narrative centers on the balance movement drivers (returns vs. transactions), whereas GS details the composition of gains and losses within the period.

comparisons.peer_summary: Level 3 fair value investments increased to $4.0 billion in 2024, driven by $536 million in transfers in and $415 million in unrealized gains, partially offset by $123 million in settlements.
comparisons.comparison: JPM and BAC both disclose the drivers of change in their Level 3 fair value measurements, specifically highlighting the role of unrealized gains/losses and transactional flows. JPM reports that Level 3 investments increased to $4.0 billion in 2024, driven by $415 million in unrealized gains and $536 million in transfers in, partially offset by settlements. BAC similarly attributes its Level 3 investment changes to asset returns (gains/losses) and net purchases/sales, noting a $16 million increase in 2023 due to $4 million in positive returns and $12 million in net purchases. Both companies identify unrealized gains/losses and net transactional flows (purchases/settlements) as key components influencing their Level 3 balances, though the magnitudes and specific operational drivers differ significantly.
